what: How often the judge changes its verdict on the same answer, re-read with the same template.

meta.note: Same-vendor half of the I1 pair, re-taken with the payload that records recordedCorrect, providerId and the unreadable-reply count. The archived reading (auditRun 43164165343) reported 412 re-graded correct, 2 flips and 2 ties; this one reports 414, 0 flips and 0 ties on the same 467 questions with the same judge (deepseek-v4-pro at temperature 0, full scorer). The two questions of difference are exactly the archived ties: a 1-1 split was excluded from both sides there and came back NO on both passes here. So the same judge reproduces to within 2 questions (0.43 pp) across runs, which is the band every gap in this pair has to be read against.
